observation.visible_scene: A top-down view of a wooden floor with a domino art layout: the word 'DOMINOES' at the top, each letter formed from black dominoes inside a rectangular outline built from white dominoes; 'VS' in the middle; 'MACHINES' at the bottom built from mixed-color dominoes (yellow, white, red, black, rainbow). A blue L-shaped piece sits at the far left edge, and a long white domino line runs down the right side connecting the top word to the bottom word. A '@HEVESH5' watermark is fixed at the lower left. The framing and all other elements stay in place throughout.
visible_changes: From the start until roughly frame 22 (≈0.73 s) the scene is essentially static: all outlines, letters and lines hold their positions.

Beginning around frame 23–24, the white rectangular outline around the first letter 'D' starts to deform: pieces along its right and lower-right edge rotate and shift outward, opening visible gaps in the outline.
The adjacent 'O' outline's lower-left corner also shows displaced/angled white pieces from about frame 25 onward.

This deformation of the leftmost outlines progresses slightly (more splayed pieces, wider gaps) through the final frame; the remaining outlines ('M','I','N','O','E','S'), the 'VS', the 'MACHINES' word, the horizontal line, the right-side vertical line, and the blue left-edge piece show no change.
No camera movement is evident: the layout, watermark and frame edges keep constant relative positions.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the partial collapse of the 'D'/'O' outlines continues, completes, or was already in progress before the crop; the clip ends mid-deformation.
What initiated the displacement — the blue piece at the left edge does not visibly move or contact anything within this segment, so any trigger lies outside the excerpt.
uncertain_details: Exact onset frame of the deformation (compression noise makes frames 22–23 borderline).
Whether the outline pieces are falling over or merely being nudged/rotated in place; only small positional shifts are visible.
The blue object at the left edge and the small yellow piece below it remain static but their role is not observable here.
